case.pattern_description: 4 online purchases were made on this card inside 30.0 minutes, each amount parked just beneath the $500 authorisation ceiling (mean headroom 5.99%), totalling $1,880.16. The shape defeats per-transaction review because every individual leg looks ordinary; only the burst as a whole is anomalous. It was found by scanning the card's recent online activity for clusters concentrated immediately below round authorisation thresholds, and matches five confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907, CC-4086, CC-4124) that the bank's own analysts could not fit to a documented typology.

sar.narrative: Customer C06881, holder of card C06881-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-03 and 2016-12-03, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,880.16 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3510950 and the transaction that triggered review being 3511062 for $472.92. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 327.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.2.2 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2208x1242', which the issuer's identity record marks 'Unknown' for this account. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. Closed investigation CC-2859 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.97 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $1,880.16.
